name: fc2-menus

scripts.build: bun scripts/build-menu-data.mjs && next build && bun run typecheck

//typescript: TypeScript 7 (native Go compiler). See CONTRIBUTING.md -> 'TypeScript 7' for the full story.
The `@typescript/native-preview` entry is an ALIAS for typescript@7 GA -- Next only accepts a
native compiler if that exact package name resolves, and the real native-preview package is a
stale 7.0.0-dev build. TS 7 ships no programmatic JS API until 7.1, so Next CANNOT type-check
the build itself; it detects the native compiler and skips type checking with a log line.
THEREFORE: the `&& bun run typecheck` at the end of `build` IS the type-safety gate. Removing
it means type errors ship silently. It must stay AFTER `next build` so .next/types route
WHEN TS 7.1 SHIPS AND NEXT SUPPORTS IT: replace the alias with a plain "typescript": "^7.x"
devDependency, point `typecheck` at node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc, and drop the
`&& bun run typecheck` from `build` since Next will type-check natively again.
